description_en: Calls the GetNetworkReachableAnalysis operation to obtain the results of a network reachability analysis task
description_zh: 调用GetNetworkReachableAnalysis接口，获取网络可达性分析结果
name: GetNetworkReachableAnalysis

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the network reachability analysis task
parameters.help_zh: 网络可达性分析任务的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network reachability analysis task. You can obtain the network reachability analysis ID by calling the CreateNetworkRearchableAnalysis operation
parameters.help_zh: 网络可达性分析任务ID。 您可以通过调用CreateNetworkRearchableAnalysis接口获取网络可达性分析ID
parameters.name: network_reachable_analysis_id
